title: Cosmic Mechanisms, Names, and the Two Substances
summary: Specific treatments answering cosmological questions: the Three Wells/summonses by which influx descends and the Living Soul ascends through differently-rooted channels; how the Wheel turns within the heavens without cleaving them because the heavens are pneumatic; why divine beings are named "gods," "rich-men," and "angels" at three discrete degrees; how the soul departs the body wearing either a garment of light or of darkness, according to which kingdom her mysteries agreed with; how the light is extracted from Hyle's storehouses, leaving her a dead body; and how the firmaments are built as a palace upon the two essences originally distinguished.
organizing_principle: Detailed answers to cosmological questions about influx, ontology, and naming — moving from rainfall and the wheel through the names of beings, garments, and the substances of the firmaments themselves.
